```{r}
outputdir <- "./figs/"
if(!dir.exists(outputdir)){
  dir.create(outputdir)
}

ggsave2_tri <- function(plot, wid = 9, hei=9){
  plot_name <- deparse(substitute(plot))
  
  #png
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".png", sep = "",collapse = "")
  ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "png",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  
  #pdf
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pdf", sep = "",collapse = "")
  # ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "pdf",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  #pptx
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pptx", sep = "",collapse = "")
  plot_ed <- rvg::dml(ggobj = plot,width = wid, height = hei)
  
  doc <- read_pptx() %>%
    add_slide('Title and Content', 'Office Theme') %>%
    ph_with(value = "", location = ph_location_type(type = "title")) %>%
    ph_with(value = plot_ed, location = ph_location(type = "body",width = cm2inch(wid), height = cm2inch(hei),left = 2, top = 2))
  doc %>%
    print(target = file_name)
  
}



inch2cm <- function(x){
  return(x/0.39370)
}
cm2inch <- function(x){
  return(0.39370*x)
}

p2cm <- function(x){
  return(as.integer(0.008466666666666667 * x))
}

cm2p <- function(x){
  return(as.integer(118.11023622047244 *x))
}

append_list <- function(l, x){
  xname  <- deparse(substitute(x))
  l[[xname]] <- x
  return(l)
}

# load function
get_vals <- function(l){
  lnames <- names(l)
  for(n in lnames){
    assign(n, l[[n]], pos = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  return(lnames)
}
```

```{r}
f3_in <- "../p2_unplanned_ICUadmission/dat/icu_target20240517_044716.297905.rds"
df_icu_target <- readRDS(f3_in)


f_adm <- "../p2_unplanned_ICUadmission/dat/admit_col78_20241019_005911_315947.csv"
df_adm_lim <- read_csv(f_adm) %>% 
  select(-starts_with("INPUT")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("CANCEL")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("UPDATE")) %>% 
  mutate(DISCHARGE_DATE = if_else(
    is.na(DISCHARGE_DATE),
    lubridate::ymd("20241019"),
    DISCHARGE_DATE
  ) %>% 
    as_datetime()) %>% 
  group_by(PT_ID) %>% 
  summarise(last_date_hosp = max(DISCHARGE_DATE)) %>% 
  mutate(org = "adm")

f_book <- "../p2_unplanned_ICUadmission/dat/book_col57_20241019_005911_315947.csv"
df_book_lim <- read_csv(f_book) %>% 
  select(-starts_with("INPUT")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("UPDATE")) %>% 
  filter(ACTUAL_TYPE =="実績") %>% 
  filter(is.na( CANCEL_DATE)) %>% 
  mutate(BOOK_DATE = BOOK_DATE%>% 
    as_datetime()) %>% 
  group_by(PT_ID) %>% 
  summarise(last_date_hosp = max(BOOK_DATE)) %>% 
  mutate(org = "book")

df_follow_dwh <- bind_rows(df_adm_lim,
                           df_book_lim) %>% 
  group_by(PT_ID) %>% 
  summarise(last_date_hosp = max(last_date_hosp))
```

```{r}
f_prof <- "../p2_unplanned_ICUadmission/dat/ptprof_col25_20241201_031325_735194.csv"
df_prof <- read_csv(f_prof) %>% 
  dplyr::select(PT_ID, DEATH_DATE, OTHER) %>%
  mutate(dts = str_extract(OTHER, pattern="死亡時刻：[0-9]*$") 
         %>%
           str_remove(.,pattern="死亡時刻：")
         )  %>% 
  mutate(dts= case_when(
    is.na(DEATH_DATE)~ NA_character_,
    !is.na(DEATH_DATE) & is.na(dts) ~ "120000",
    T~dts)) %>% 
  mutate(deathdate =str_c(as.character(DEATH_DATE), dts, sep=" ")) %>%
  mutate(deathdate = lubridate::ymd_hms(deathdate) %>% 
           as_datetime())

```


```{r}
df_icu_target %>% 
  filter(!PT_ID %in% df_prof$PT_ID) %>% nrow()
```

```{r}
df_icu_target_wd <- df_icu_target %>% 
  left_join(df_prof, by="PT_ID") %>% 
  left_join(df_follow_dwh, by="PT_ID") %>% 
  mutate(event = if_else(is.na(deathdate), 0, 1),
         time_to_event = case_when(
           is.na(deathdate)~last_date_hosp -ADM_DT,
           deathdate -ADM_DT < 0~disc_u_DT -ADM_DT,
           T ~deathdate -ADM_DT
         ) %>% 
           as.numeric() %>% 
           magrittr::divide_by(60*60*24)) %>% 
  mutate(death_in_30days= time_to_event <= 30 & event == 1) %>% 
  mutate(death_in_7days= time_to_event <= 7 & event == 1) %>% 
  select(event, time_to_event,
         disc_outcome,
         disc_u_finalstate,death_in_30days,
         everything())


df_icu_target_wd$event %>% table()
```

```{r}
add_3_list <- function(l_){
  l_ <- list()
  l_ <- list()
  l_ <- list()
  return(l_)
}
l_coef <- list() %>% 
  add_3_list()

l_roc <- list() %>% 
  add_3_list()

l_proc <- list() %>% 
  add_3_list()

l_models <- list() %>% 
  add_3_list()

l_data <- list() %>% 
  add_3_list()

l_auc <- list() %>% 
  add_3_list()

for(i in 1:length(fs)){
  tic()
  f_in_l <- fs[[i]]
  print(f_in_l)
  
  xtag <- f_in_l %>% 
    str_remove(".//ssm_801_4_redvar_rs_") %>% 
    str_extract("^[a-zA-Z]*")
  
  readRDS(f_in_l) %>%
    get_vals()
  
  res <- ft1 %>% 
    rstan::extract() 

  ft1 %>% rhat() %>% mcmc_rhat()
  
  
  df_j_ijdt_res <- df_j_ijdt %>% 
  mutate(
         estim_dmg = 
           res$dmg_ijs %>% 
           apply(., 2, mean)
         )



  df_j_res <- df_j %>% 
    mutate(
           estim_phi = 
             res$phi_ijs %>% 
             apply(., 2, mean))  %>% 
  
    left_join(
      df_j_ijdt_res %>% 
        select(ind_i, ind_j, ind_ij, estim_dmg),
      by=c("ind_i", "ind_j", "ind_ij")
    )

  
  df_icu_target_lim <- df_icu_target_wd %>% 
    mutate(LOS = as.numeric(difftime(disc_u_DT, ADM_DT, units = "secs")) / 60 / 60) %>%
    mutate(log2_LOS = log2(LOS)) %>% 
    mutate(disc_u_outcome = ifelse(disc_u_finalstate == "死亡", 1, 0)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(one_of(
      cols_need,
      cols_eval))
  
  
  df_icu_target_lim_na <- df_icu_target_lim %>% 
  filter(is.na(LOS))
  
  df_j_res_me <- df_j_res %>% 
    dplyr::select(
      JIPAD_ID,
      estim_dmg,
      # event,
      # time_to_event,
      delta_obs_time_cmp,
      next_obs_time_cmp,
      hrs
    ) %>% 
    # group_by(JIPAD_ID) %>%
    filter(hrs <= 24) %>% 
    mutate(nhrs = -hrs)
  
  
  p_tr <- ggplot()+
        theme_pubr(legend="none")+
      theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
    geom_line(data=df_j_res_me,
               aes(x=nhrs,y=estim_dmg, group=JIPAD_ID, color=JIPAD_ID))+
    ggtitle(xtag)
  
  p_tr %>% 
    grid::grid.draw()

  
  m <- lme4::lmer(estim_dmg ~ nhrs + (1 +nhrs|JIPAD_ID) , data = df_j_res_me )
  # m <- nlme::lme(estim_dmg ~ nhrs|JIPAD_ID, data = df_j_res_me )
  m %>% print()
  
  m_smr <- m %>% 
  summary()
  
  m_smr %>% print()
  
  df_me_smr <- m %>% coef() %>% .[[1]] %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    mutate(JIPAD_ID = rownames(.)) %>% 
    `colnames<-`(c("damage_intercept", "damage_slope", "JIPAD_ID"))
  # df_me_smr 
  
  df_j_res_last_range <- df_j_res %>% 
    dplyr::select(
      JIPAD_ID,
      estim_dmg,
      # event,
      # time_to_event,
      delta_obs_time_cmp,
      next_obs_time_cmp,
      hrs
    ) %>% 
    # group_by(JIPAD_ID) %>%
    filter(hrs <= 24) %>%
    mutate(estim_dmg_area = estim_dmg * next_obs_time_cmp) %>% 
    group_by(JIPAD_ID) %>%
    summarise(n_obs=n(),
              estim_mean_dmg = sum(estim_dmg_area)/sum(next_obs_time_cmp)) %>%  
  # %>%    
  # summarise(n_obs=n(),
  #           estim_mean_dmg = mean(estim_dmg)) %>%
  # filter(min(hrs) == hrs) %>%
  # mutate(estim_mean_dmg = estim_dmg) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>% 
    left_join(df_icu_target_lim,
              by="JIPAD_ID") %>% 
    left_join(df_me_smr, by="JIPAD_ID")


  
  
  for( dmg in c("estim_mean_dmg"
    # ,"damage_intercept",
    # "damage_slope"
      )){
      for (ev in c("death_in_30days", "death_in_7days")){
        print(f_in_l)
        print(ev)
        xlab <- dmg
        df_j_res_last_range[["x"]] <- df_j_res_last_range[[dmg]]
        df_j_res_last_range[["y"]] <- df_j_res_last_range[[ev]]
      
      p_ev <- ggplot()+
        theme_pubr(legend="none")+
        theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
        geom_histogram(data = df_j_res_last_range,
                       aes(x=x),
                       position = "identity",
                       bins=25)+
        xlab(ev)+
        coord_cartesian(expand = F)+
        ggtitle(xtag)
      
      grid::grid.draw(p_ev)
      
      p_long_ev <- ggplot()+
        theme_pubr()+
        theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
        geom_point(data = df_j_res_last_range,
                  aes(x=x,
                      y=y,
                      # group=JIPAD_ID,
                      # color=y
                      ))+
        # coord_cartesian(expand = F)+
        # scale_x_log10()+scale_y_log10()+
        # scale_colour_viridis(option = "viridis") +
        # scale_fill_viridis(option = "viridis")+
        labs(color=ev)+xlab(xlab)+ylab(ev)+
        ggtitle(xtag)
      # +
        # facet_wrap(~categ, ncol = 1,scale="free")
    
      grid::grid.draw(p_long_ev)
      
      
      if(ev %in% c(
        # "disc_u_outcome",
        "death_in_30days", "death_in_7days")){
        
        print(ev)
        df_j_res_last_range_fix <- df_j_res_last_range %>% 
                         mutate(y = if_else(
                           y == 1,
                           "death_in",
                           "survival"
                         ))
        x1 <- df_j_res_last_range_fix %>% 
          filter(y=="death_in") %>% 
          .[["x"]]
        x2 <- df_j_res_last_range_fix %>% 
          filter(y=="survival") %>% 
          .[["x"]]
        # print(x1)
        # print(x2)
        exactRankTests::wilcox.exact(x = x1, y=x2, paired=F) %>% print()
        # brunner.munzel.test(x1, x2) %>% print()
        
        p_out <- ggplot()+
          theme_pubr(base_family = "Times")+
          theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
          geom_boxplot(data = df_j_res_last_range_fix,
                       aes(x=y,
                           y=x), width=0.5)+
          geom_dotplot(data = df_j_res_last_range_fix,
                       aes(x=y,
                           y=x,),
                       binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center",dotsize=0.3)+
          xlab(ev)+ylab(xlab)+
          ggtitle(xtag)
        
        grid::grid.draw(p_out)
      }
      # 
      model_formula <- c("x") %>%
        # str_c(collapse =  " + ") %>%
        c(ev,  "~",.) %>%
        str_c(collapse =" ")
      print(model_formula)
    
      if(ev %in% c(
        # "disc_u_outcome",
                   "death_in_30days", "death_in_7days")){
        model <- glm(model_formula, data = df_j_res_last_range, family = binomial("logit"))
        
        l_models[[ev]][[f_in_l]] <- model
        l_data[[ev]][[f_in_l]] <- df_j_res_last_range %>% 
          mutate(xtag = xtag)
        
        
        # pred_temp <- model %>% 
        #   predict(type = "response")  %>% 
        #   ROCR::prediction(labels = df_j_res_last_range$y == 1)
        roc <- model %>% 
          predict(type = "response")  %>% 
          ROCR::prediction(labels = df_j_res_last_range$y == 1) %>%
          performance("tpr", "fpr")
        
        auc_val <- model %>% 
          predict(type = "response")  %>% 
          ROCR::prediction(labels = df_j_res_last_range$y == 1) %>%
          performance("auc") %>% 
          .@y.values %>% 
          .[[1]]

        # 
        l_auc[[ev]][[f_in_l]] <- auc_val
        
        df_roc <- data.frame(tpr = roc@y.values[[1]], fpr = roc@x.values[[1]])
        
        l_roc[[ev]][[f_in_l]] <- df_roc %>% 
          mutate(f = f_in_l)
        
        
        p_roc <- ggplot(df_roc, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr)) + 
          theme_pubr(base_family = "Times")+
          theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
          geom_line(color = "red") +
          geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
          coord_fixed() +
          labs(x = "(1 - Spec)", y = "Sens")+
          ggtitle(xtag)
        
        p_roc %>% grid::grid.draw()
        
        l_proc[[ev]][[f_in_l]] <- p_roc
        
      }else{
        
      cor( df_j_res_last_range$x,  df_j_res_last_range$y, method = "spearman") %>% 
          print()
        model <- glm(model_formula, data = df_j_res_last_range)
    
      }
    
      model %>%
        summary() %>%
        print()
      
      df_coef <- model %>% 
        summary() %>% 
        coef() %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        mutate(variables = rownames(.)) %>% 
        mutate(y=ev) %>% 
        mutate(f = f_in_l) %>% 
        mutate(xtag = xtag)
      l_coef[[ev]][[xtag]] <- df_coef
      }
    }
  
  
  toc()
  
  # break
  
}
```
